concept: A product launch where the product is Cinen Hamila: one iPhone 16 Pro in Desert Titanium in a dark studio, his profile, his name, CEO in real gold letters, his method as a stack of words, the proof as a gold counter, Magik Management's site, the DM that starts it all.
system: Bebas Neue for every big word (fit to the width, letters rising out of a mask), Space Mono 700 for the running labels (scrambled in), gold #F4C752 for one thing per screen, paper #EEEAE3 on near-black. Real 3D for the phone and the gold letters (three.js, studio maps, no direct lights). Cuts and words on Beat Thee's hits (91 BPM).
